verdict.rationale: Jan exposes a built-in OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337 that it describes as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs. That implies developers can call it from Python or JavaScript using existing OpenAI-compatible SDKs, but nothing shows Jan ships its own official client libraries. Missing for 10: first-party Python/JavaScript SDKs, documented code examples for calling the server from those languages, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of SDK usage.
